# Phostide

> Free, MIT-licensed Windows 11 utility that paints OLED-safe animated themes into the real taskbar background (Explorer BackgroundFill), not a floating overlay.

Site: https://phostide.doticca.com
Source: https://github.com/teamdoticca/Phostide
Publisher: Doticca (https://doticca.com)
Full agent brief: https://phostide.doticca.com/llms-full.txt

## Product

- Platform: Windows 11 22H2+ (x64). Signed Setup.exe is per-user — no administrator rights.
- Standalone: does **not** require Windhawk, TranslucentTB, RainbowTaskbar, or any separate taskbar overlay.
- Mechanism: tray host injects ExplorerTAP into Explorer; paints each taskbar's own `BackgroundFill`. Icons, Start, tray, and clock stay on top. Quitting restores the normal Windows brushes. Does not modify system files.
- Themes: exactly five built-in — Rainbow, Sea Waves, Weather, Space, Aurora. There is **no theme editor** and no custom theme upload.
- Privacy: local by default — no account, no telemetry; themes work offline; optional GitHub update check only.
- Distribution: signed Setup.exe and portable zip via GitHub Releases (also linked from the site).

## Settings (tray › Settings…)

Three tabs — do not confuse them:

| Tab | What it controls |
|-----|------------------|
| **Taskbar** | Scope **All** or monitor *N*, then theme + intensity (0–100%). Live preview; **Apply** commits. |
| **Monitors** | Per-display **on/off** only. Off = stock Windows taskbar. Default: all on. |
| **System** | App-global only: **RENDERING** Auto / GPU / CPU (shared by every bar — not per-monitor), Start with Windows, check for updates. |

Defaults after reset: Rainbow, 45% intensity, Auto rendering, all monitors active. Settings file: `%APPDATA%\Phostide\settings.json`.

## Dual-monitor OLED recipe

1. Install Setup.exe (or run portable `Phostide.exe`).
2. Tray › Settings… › **Monitors** — leave the OLED on; uncheck the LCD (or other) display if you want it stock.
3. **Taskbar** › Apply to the OLED monitor number › pick **Space** or **Aurora** › modest intensity › **Apply**.
4. **System** › RENDERING **Auto** (recommended start); optionally enable Start with Windows › Apply.

Honest limit: Phostide only animates the background fill. Static icons, Start, tray, and clock still age OLED pixels; motion is not a burn-in warranty.

## Not Phostide

- Not an overlay window on top of the taskbar
- Not Windows auto-hide
- Not a Windhawk mod and not dependent on Windhawk
- Not a theme editor / custom shader UI for end users
- Not a cloud service
